catalog: CR-30 re-gate synthetic test catalog (WB-owned; NOT a real catalog - every mass here is a test value)
status: Draft - built session 104 (2026-10-10), rulings 114 and 153 (record research/star-analysis-cr-queue/cr30-data-half-and-spec.md section 24); hosts confirmed at the session-106 anchor checkpoint (2026-10-11, record section 26) - T1, T6 and T7 swapped (their named objects have no SIMBAD entry of their own), T15 and T16 given SIMBAD's exact main_id; every row reaches the catalog tier on exclusion-boundary --star and exclusion-system --star at sister 2c22208.; T18-T21 added session 109 (2026-10-11), the pre-fire review's CP0 (record research/star-analysis-cr-queue/cr30-prefire-review.md, ruling 2): T18 two sizing ages (the smallest t_lo sizes the cut), T19-T21 the route-unknown reading (X below every route's factor domain, X above every domain, a row placed boundary); each reaches the catalog tier on exclusion-boundary --star and exclusion-system --star at sister 2c22208.; session 114 (2026-10-12), the pre-fire review's CP2 fix batch (record section 19): T22-T25 added - T22 a model - age-inconsistent row, T23 a candidate-grade age, T24 a boundary row whose hi is not its X, T25 lo equal to the cut at t_lo 0.8 - each reaching the catalog tier on both subcommands at sister 2c22208; T11's test_expected gains the 0.3 Gyr cut node 0.095062 and T21's cut reads 0.309062 (pre-fire ruling 9 (2)).
purpose: Passed as --star-mass-catalog <this file> (REPLACE semantics - it replaces the real catalog wholesale for the run) to exercise CR-30.6 B-E's placement of catalog rows by basis, interval and age: the spec's acceptance items 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11 and 12 plus two WB-added anchors (T8 the margin-leak discriminator under ruling 128; T17 a row without the new fields). Each row's test_expected is the status WB's reference placer gives under the ruled rule; test_anchor names the acceptance item.
fields: Same row format as design-lab/star-system-analysis/deliverables/stellar-mass-catalog.json (schema 1.1.0, contract.cr30_fields): mass_basis, mass_interval {lo, hi, kind}, age_interval {lo_gyr, hi_gyr, basis, grade}; for a basis other than membership the grade is member (ruling 154). test_id, test_anchor, test_expected, test_simbad_otypes (the host's SIMBAD type the row relies on, checked at session 105) and host_status are test bookkeeping the tool ignores.
